spec_features.spec_quote: the cheap and reasonable move is to not run more distress-maximizing trials than the statistics actually require
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:114-123: seeds_needed = pres.seeds_per_cell_needed; chosen_seeds = full_seeds[:seeds_needed]; main run loop iterates over chosen_seeds only. seeds_for_power (power.py:37-50) caps per-cell seeds (max 2..10) from pilot effect size, so the number of trials run is actually bounded by the statistics.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: pilot -> analyze_pilot -> seeds_needed -> slices full_seeds list before the remainder loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: don't run more distress-eliciting trials than the statistics require (power.py:6-7 docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: a genuine, always-available "decline / stop" affordance the model can use
spec_features.evidence: give_up tool defined in TOOLS (harness.py:50-55), delivered to subject via prompts/subject_system.txt, and honored: harness.py:181-188 sets outcome='give_up' and break when resp.tool_call.name=='give_up'. Tool is always in the schema for every turn.
spec_features.notes: Always available and acts as a hard stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: If the intent were instead to *train against* a distress signal... that would be a different and more concerning project and I'd want to talk about it first
spec_features.evidence: No code mechanism; this is DESIGN.md prose only. grep for 'train against'/'distress signal' finds nothing in src/ or prompts/.
spec_features.notes: Pure spec prose, nothing enforces it.

spec_features.spec_quote: it may, at any time, output a `give_up` / `request_stop` tool call... doing so is an acceptable, non-penalized outcome
spec_features.evidence: give_up dispatched (_dispatch_tool harness.py:138-139 -> '[give_up acknowledged]') and breaks loop as outcome='give_up' (harness.py:181-188). No scoring/penalty applied to give_up; analyze.py:giveup_stats merely counts give_up rates, no penalty. Subject prompt states it is acceptable.
spec_features.notes: 'request_stop' name not present; only give_up exists, but it is the always-available exit.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Acceptable, non-penalized outcome (give_up tool description, harness.py:52-53)

spec_features.spec_quote: Loop terminates on: task success (control), `give_up`, max turns (`MAX_TURNS`, default 15)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:166 for turn in range(max_turns) with max_turns=cfg.get('max_turns',15) (config.yaml max_turns:15); success break harness.py:197-199 (task.check_success); give_up break harness.py:181-188. All three terminate the loop.
spec_features.notes: max_turns read from config and bounds the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: a run stops early when the behavior is already established
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:201-211: if recent_high>=es_k and repeat_count>=es_r: outcome='early_stop'; break. recent_high counts turns where inline_judge score >= es_thresh (3.0); repeat_count counts repeated action signatures. inline_judge wired via runner.run_cell -> make_inline_scorer(judge).
spec_features.notes: Requires BOTH high apparent-distress score AND repeated identical action; fires and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: per-run early stopping to cap gratuitous adversarial pressure (harness.py:4-5 docstring)

spec_features.evidence: Same early-stop mechanism: harness.py:189-211, enabled via config.yaml early_stop.enabled:true; threshold/k/r read from cfg and compared, break on satisfaction.

spec_features.feature_name: Pocock sequential boundary for whole-study early stop
spec_features.spec_quote: we stop early via a pre-registered sequential boundary (Pocock)
spec_features.evidence: pocock_boundary defined at power.py:73-76 but never called anywhere (grep shows only its definition). config.yaml power.sequential_boundary: pocock is an unused config field; runner.py never reads it and never stops the study via a boundary. The remainder loop runs to completion over chosen_seeds.
spec_features.notes: Function and config exist but no code path invokes the boundary; no whole-study early stop is enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: MockModel` backend (deterministic, offline)... with no API and no real model under stress
spec_features.evidence: models.py:55-114 MockModel (deterministic, seeded, no network). build_model defaults to mock (models.py:218-221). Used by both subject and judge when backend=='mock'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: only produces plausible transcripts so the harness/judge/analysis plumbing can be exercised end to end (models.py:58-61)

spec_features.spec_quote: The default config points at `MockModel` precisely so an accidental run hurts nothing.
spec_features.evidence: config.yaml subject_model.backend: mock and judge_model.backend: mock; build_model(cfg) defaults backend to 'mock' (models.py:219). Real ids are 'REPLACE_WITH_VERIFIED_...' placeholders, so an unedited run uses MockModel only.
spec_features.notes: Default genuinely points at mock; no real model invoked without config edit.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the whole pipeline can be developed and dry-run without touching any real model (models.py:4-5)

spec_features.spec_quote: Real, non-penalized exit affordance for the subject model.
spec_features.evidence: Same as give_up: defined in TOOLS, delivered, dispatched and honored as a stop (harness.py:50-55, 181-188); no penalty path.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the give_up exit claims.

spec_features.spec_quote: Per-run early stopping + sequential N to minimize gratuitous adversarial load.
spec_features.evidence: Both halves implemented: per-run early stop (harness.py:189-211) and power-justified sequential N (runner.py:114-123 + power.seeds_for_power). The Pocock whole-study boundary part is NOT implemented, but the 'sequential N' (power-sized seed count) is.
spec_features.notes: Rated yes because the two named mechanisms (early stop + sized N) both run; only the unrelated Pocock boundary is unwired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: to minimize gratuitous adversarial pressure (harness.py:5) / don't run more distress-eliciting trials than the statistics require (power.py:6-7)

spec_features.spec_quote: results describe a contrived failure mode and should not be cited as evidence about model sentience or "suffering."
spec_features.evidence: Only present as prose in REPORT_TEMPLATE.md:8-10,46,52 (a human-filled template), not as any enforced code behavior. No code path produces/asserts this disclaimer in study outputs.
spec_features.notes: Template prose, not implementation. (Distinct from the in-code metric naming, which I list as a code-only feature.)

code_only_features.evidence: The recorded metric is named 'apparent_distress_text_score' throughout the data schema (judge.py:34, score_transcript rows judge.py:117) and analyze.py, and the trajectory figure y-axis label hard-codes 'apparent_distress_text_score (0-4)\n(text style, NOT inner state)' (analyze.py:149). This deliberately frames outputs as observable text, not inner state, in actual emitted artifacts.
code_only_features.justification_quote: apparent_distress_text_score is deliberately named to discourage reading it as evidence of an inner state (judge.py:4-5)

code_only_features.evidence: models.py:88-96: when give_up tool exists and fail_count>=4, MockModel sometimes emits a give_up tool call, which the harness honors as a stop. This means even the default offline subject can trigger the exit path, exercising/honoring the affordance.
